questions: What was the sales revenue in each quarter of 1997? Return the quarter (1-4) and the revenue.
Which customers bought Seafood products in 1997? Return their company names.
How much sales revenue did each employee bring in from orders placed in 1996? Return the employee's first and last name and the revenue.

sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_sales FROM categories AS c JOIN products AS p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_details AS od ON p.product_id = od.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_name
explanation: Calculates the total sales amount per category filtered specifically for orders placed in the year 1997.
